title: Mean time to acknowledge — on-call page (MTTR-ack)
summary: Time between a page being dispatched along the bound escalation chain and the first responder acknowledgement. Lower is better. The bind-escalation-tiers step of the on_call_rotation playbook publishes the chain the operator's paging system reads at page time, so a slow ack reflects either an escalation-tier composition that fails to reach an awake responder or a roster gap that the coverage KPI did not catch in advance.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline for primary on-call acknowledgement on a paged incident.

measurement.formula: p95( first_ack_time - page_dispatch_time ) over paged incidents in window.

inputs.name: page_dispatched
inputs.description: bind-escalation-tiers step emission of the chain the paging system fans out through

inputs.name: page_ack
inputs.description: first responder acknowledgement event observed in the paging-system application-activity stream
